description: Xenomoon Forge hooks — auto-route Bash through rtk when it's installed (rtk-rewrite: token-filtered command output, silent no-op on machines without rtk), block destructive git/shell ops before they run, hold the orchestrator to its ROLE in terminal sessions too (block-main-loop-mutations: mutating git denied for the MAIN LOOP only — sub-agents and read-only git untouched — and merge/promote surfaced as a human ASK; the web UI enforces the same class via canUseTool, which a terminal session never loads), consent-gate Codex reviews (require-codex-consent: any codex-companion review surfaces ONE harness approval prompt — the prompt IS the consent), grant sub-agent project/library edits so backgrounded workers aren't auto-denied, re-inject the caveman terse-output rule on every sub-agent tool call so it survives long turns, log rtk usage (observe-only — now measures what actually ran, post-rewrite), dedup byte-identical repeat Read calls (deny a same-view re-read when mtime is unchanged and still recent — token-audit read-dedup, emits policy:"read-dedup"), nudge the first raw Grep/Glob of a session toward `graphify query` when the searched repo has a knowledge graph (one-shot deny then all-allow — token-audit graphify-first, emits policy:"graphify-first"), capture correction-shaped user turns into the project's debrief queue mechanically (UserPromptSubmit — the learning loop's backstop when task momentum wins), and (opt-in) refresh the project's graphify knowledge graph after edits (PostToolUse — AST-only graphify update; OFF by default, enabled per-project via graphify-out/.autoupdate or XENOMOON_GRAPHIFY_AUTOUPDATE).
